# Generated by classify_tests.py from each test's own project includes, then reviewed.
#
# Two folders are deliberately imprecise, and saying so is the point:
#   * a bare subsystem (`gpu:`, `hle:`) means every header the test includes is one that most
#     tests include, so the evidence supports the subsystem and nothing finer.
#   * `misc:` means the top folders tied within 15%. The tool has no answer; these are parked
#     together rather than filed under a guess.
# Tests with no project include at all are absent from this plan entirely and stay at the tests
# root, for the same reason.
